patch_description: This replaces the random-point baseline with a deterministic two-stage maximin optimizer. First, a batched differential-evolution search evaluates all 286 triangle areas simultaneously for many candidate configurations. It uses a lower-tail objective, rewarding both the smallest triangle and the next-smallest triangles to avoid fragile near-collinear arrangements. Second, the strongest candidates receive affine-invariant stochastic local polishing using the normalized minimum-area objective directly. All points remain inside the unit square, which is a convex region of unit area, and the fixed seed makes results reproducible.
